parameters.$filter: aaca_key eq 'AttendanceAppUrl' or aaca_key eq 'AbsenceAlertImageUrl' or aaca_key eq 'AbsenceAlertFallbackEmail'

parameters.body/messageBody:
{
  "type": "AdaptiveCard",
  "$schema": "https://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json",
  "version": "1.5",
  "body": [
    {
      "type": "Container",
      "showBorder": true,
      "roundedCorners": true,
      "style": "warning",
      "bleed": true,
      "id": "con_Container",
      "rtl": false,
      "backgroundImage": {
        "url": "@{coalesce(first(body('Setting_AbsenceAlertImageUrl'))?['aaca_value'], '')}"
      },
      "items": [
        {
          "type": "Badge",
          "size": "ExtraLarge",
          "text": "ABSENCE ALERT",
          "horizontalAlignment": "Center",
          "id": "icn_Absence",
          "shape": "Rounded"
        },
        {
          "type": "ProgressBar",
          "id": "lbl_Progress",
          "spacing": "Small",
          "horizontalAlignment": "Center"
        },
        {
          "type": "TextBlock",
          "text": "Date Notified: @{formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_noticeat'], 'Pacific Standard Time'), 'MM/dd/yyyy - h:mm tt')}",
          "wrap": true,
          "id": "txt_date",
          "weight": "Bolder",
          "color": "Accent"
        },
        {
          "type": "TextBlock",
          "text": "Student Name: @{coalesce(first(body('Matched_student')?['value'])?['aaca_displayname'], concat(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_typedfirstname'], ' ', triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_typedlastname']))}",
          "wrap": true,
          "id": "txt_student",
          "weight": "Bolder",
          "color": "Accent"
        },
        {
          "type": "TextBlock",
          "wrap": true,
          "id": "txt_match",
          "weight": "Bolder",
          "color": "@{if(or(equals(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_matchstatus'], 582100000), equals(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_matchstatus'], 582100003)), 'Good', 'Attention')}",
          "text": "@{if(or(equals(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_matchstatus'], 582100000), equals(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_matchstatus'], 582100003)), 'Matched to this student in the attendance app', 'Could not match this student - map it in the app (Absences > Mapping Errors)')}"
        },
        {
          "type": "TextBlock",
          "text": "Submitted By: @{if(equals(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_source'], 582100001), concat('Office - ', coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['_createdby_value@OData.Community.Display.V1.FormattedValue'], 'staff')), triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_parentname'])}",
          "wrap": true,
          "id": "txt_SubBy",
          "weight": "Bolder",
          "color": "Accent"
        },
        {
          "type": "TextBlock",
          "text": "Relationship to Student: @{if(empty(coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_relationshiptext'], '')), '-', triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_relationshiptext'])}",
          "wrap": true,
          "id": "txt_Relationship",
          "weight": "Bolder",
          "color": "Accent"
        },
        {
          "type": "TextBlock",
          "text": "Date of Absence: @{formatDateTime(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_absencestart'], 'MM/dd/yyyy')}",
          "wrap": true,
          "id": "txt_DOA",
          "weight": "Bolder",
          "color": "Accent"
        },
        {
          "type": "TextBlock",
          "text": "Expected Date of Return: @{if(empty(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_returndate']), '-', formatDateTime(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_returndate'], 'MM/dd/yyyy'))}",
          "wrap": true,
          "id": "txt_DOR",
          "weight": "Bolder",
          "color": "Accent"
        },
        {
          "type": "TextBlock",
          "text": "Reason: @{coalesce(triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_reasontext'], '')}",
          "wrap": true,
          "id": "txt_Reason",
          "weight": "Bolder",
          "color": "Accent"
        },
        {
          "type": "TextBlock",
          "text": "Reference: @{triggerOutputs()?['body']?['aaca_reference']}",
          "wrap": true,
          "id": "txt_Ref",
          "weight": "Bolder",
          "color": "Accent"
        },
        {
          "type": "TextBlock",
          "text": "This alert is for your own awareness, nothing further is required.",
          "wrap": true,
          "color": "Attention",
          "id": "txt_footer",
          "horizontalAlignment": "Center",
          "weight": "Lighter"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "actions": [
    {
      "type": "Action.OpenUrl",
      "title": "Open in app",
      "url": "@{concat(coalesce(first(body('Setting_AttendanceAppUrl'))?['aaca_value'], ''), if(contains(coalesce(first(body('Setting_AttendanceAppUrl'))?['aaca_value'], ''), '?'), '&', '?'), 'screen=absences')}"
    }
  ]
}
